name: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel
summary: At Tarren Mill, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's bounty calls for every Syndicate member's death. The Forsaken want the brigands driven from Durnholde Keep before they threaten Horde operations in the foothills.

sections.title: A Standing Execution Order
sections.body: The Syndicate's sudden arrival southeast of Tarren Mill has drawn the Forsaken's attention. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her commanders see the Syndicate as a plague, not displaced nobles to bargain with. Her bounty orders their immediate death. Any prisoners brought in will be executed without trial.

sections.title: The Ruins of Durnholde
sections.body: Durnholde Keep was once an infamous internment fortress. Now it lies shattered and lawless. Syndicate Rogues and Watchmen have taken its crumbling ramparts and towers as an operations hub. High Executor Darthalia needs the armed bandits driven out to secure the road and protect Tarren Mill's southeastern approach.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for Syndicate personnel?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner issued the bounty under her direct authority, and it hangs on Tarren Mill's notice board. High Executor Darthalia, the settlement's military commander, collects proof of execution.

faq.q: Where are these Syndicate members located?
faq.answer: Syndicate members gather among Durnholde Keep's shattered stones, southeast of Tarren Mill across the river. Others are around the ruined guard tower just south of the fortress.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want them dead instead of captured?
faq.answer: The Forsaken see the Syndicate as treacherous pests and an armed threat on their territory. The decree orders captured members executed without trial, so there is no point in taking them alive.

faq.q: What is the Syndicate doing in Durnholde Keep?
faq.answer: The Syndicate is made up mostly of disgraced Alteraci nobles and mercenaries. Across Lordaeron, its members use abandoned keeps, ruins, and towers as bases to raid settlements, rob travelers, and rebuild their shattered power.

faq.q: What happens after culling these Syndicate operatives?
faq.answer: Once the local Rogues and Watchmen are thinned, High Executor Darthalia issues a high-priority bounty on their leader, Baron Vardus.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you have practical reason to clear Alterac's living noble remnants if you are to hold the hills of Lordaeron without challenge.
Durnholde Keep carries grim memories for the Horde. Orcs were once held captive in this internment fortress, so clearing its brigands carries symbolic weight.
The Syndicate has skilled cutpurses and ambushers throughout Durnholde. You face rival practitioners of stealth.
